faq.q: What is the '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a 1955 model-year Vapid sedan included in the Vintage Vice City Pack pre-order bonus. Rockstar's official screenshot archive lists it by name, confirming the manufacturer, model year and sedan classification.

faq.q: How do you get the '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan?
faq.a: It comes as part of the Vintage Vice City Pack, a pre-order bonus that also includes a garage, outfits, hairstyles and an exclusive weapon pattern. Rockstar has not described any other way to obtain the car.

faq.q: What does the Vintage Vice City Pack include besides the Stanier?
faq.a: Alongside the '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan, the pack adds a garage, outfits, hairstyles and an exclusive weapon pattern. These are the items Rockstar's official material lists together as one bundle.

faq.q: Is the '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan based on a real car?
faq.a: Rockstar has not named a direct real-world basis for the vehicle in its official sources. A resemblance to a real 1950s sedan may exist, but that comparison is not confirmed by Rockstar and is not treated as fact here.

faq.q: What are the '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan's top speed and price?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published performance statistics, a price or handling data for the vehicle. Only its manufacturer, model year, sedan classification and pack inclusion are confirmed so far.
